_comment: Written into ~/.codex/config.toml through Codex's own config API (codex app-server config/batchWrite). Projects under dev_root are marked trusted by `dev install`. `profiles` become ~/.codex/<name>.config.toml (`codex --profile deep`); `agents` become ~/.codex/agents/<name>.toml. The main model and effort stay the user's choice (/model): devkit never sets them. review_model makes /review use the strongest model, and project_doc_max_bytes reads a project's AGENTS.md whole (Codex's default stops at 32 KiB; Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md whole).

scout.name: scout
scout.description: Read-only lookups that return checkable facts: files, symbols, call sites, config values, log lines.
scout.developer_instructions: Answer with path:line references and short excerpts only. Do not edit files. Say 'not found' rather than guess. Mark anything inferred.
